title: Get Information About a View
description: Learn various ways to retrieve view definition and metadata using system catalog views and stored procedures.

data.text: SQL Server provides several ways to get information about a view, including system catalog views and stored procedures.

data.title: Query sys.sql_modules for view definition
data.content: Retrieves the view definition using the system catalog.
data.code:
SELECT
    definition,
    uses_ansi_nulls,
    uses_quoted_identifier,
    is_schema_bound
FROM
    sys.sql_modules
WHERE
    object_id = object_id('sales.daily_sales');

data.title: sp_helptext for view definition
data.content: Returns the definition of a view using the sp_helptext stored procedure.

data.title: OBJECT_DEFINITION for view info
data.content: Retrieves view definition using OBJECT_DEFINITION and OBJECT_ID functions.

data.title: View Information Key Points
points: sys.sql_modules stores the definition of views and other modules.
sp_helptext is a convenient stored procedure for viewing object definitions.
OBJECT_DEFINITION() returns the definition of a schema-scoped object.
All three methods return the same view definition text.
